_purpose: Pinned exit code per enforcement control. scripts/enforcement/ci-baseline.mjs fails the job when a control does WORSE than its baseline, or when a control cannot be measured at all. Known debt is permitted and pinned here; new debt is not. This is the ratchet that replaces continue-on-error, which reported success on a failing control.
_howToChange: Lower a baselineExit when the debt is actually cleared, in the same commit that clears it. Never RAISE a baselineExit to make a red build green — that converts a defect into a specification and makes the eventual fix read as a regression.
_tiers: BLOCKING means the control has been verified by violation: it was made to fail on an injected defect and observed passing again after a byte-identical restore. REPORTING means it runs and is ratcheted but has not been violation-verified, so its green is weaker evidence.
